rows.note: Use 懵 as the all-purpose colloquial choice when a person cannot think clearly or feels disoriented.

example.english: I’m confused because I didn’t get enough sleep.
example.traditional: 我今日瞓唔夠，成個人懵晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 fan3 m4 gau3 sing4 go3 jan4 mung2 saai3

rows.note: Use this when someone is confused because they do not understand information or what is happening.

example.english: All those technical terms have left me confused.
example.traditional: 你講咁多專有名詞，搞到我一頭霧水。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 gam3 do1 zyun1 jau5 ming4 ci4 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when things, information, or a situation are jumbled and chaotic rather than when a person is mentally confused.

example.english: The meeting materials are all confused and jumbled, so no one knows which version to read.
example.traditional: 會議啲資料排到亂晒龍，大家都唔知睇邊份。
example.jyutping: wui6 ji5 di1 zi1 liu2 paai4 dou3 lyun6 saai3 lung4 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 tai2 bin1 fan6
